title: A current takes the same value on test forms that agree on an open neighbourhood of its support
statement: Assume (VO), the exact frozen statement of dtc_vanish_off_support, which appears verbatim as the first hypothesis of the Lean statement: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every current S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (TestFormOn U n) whose topological support is disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U and G be subsets of ℝ^P, let X ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k) be a current and let φ₁, φ₂ ∈ 𝒟^k(U) (TestFormOn U k) be test forms. Suppose G is open, spt X ⊆ G (X.support, Simon 6.2.11), and φ₁(x) = φ₂(x) for every x ∈ G. Then X(φ₁) = X(φ₂).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (φ₁ φ₂ : TestFormOn U k), IsOpen G → X.support ⊆ G → EqOn (φ₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (φ₂ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) G → X φ₁ = X φ₂
